name: Omafin
author: omafin contributors
description: Your Jellyfin movies and shows in a native Omarchy window: continue watching, next up, libraries, details, search and a keyboard-first player with skip intro and up next. Hands any video to mpv in one key. Follows your Omarchy theme.

barWidget.description: Your Jellyfin library. A dot shows while mpv plays something from Omafin; click it to open the window.

schema.label: Show the icon in the bar
schema.description: Turn this off to keep Omafin out of the bar. Open the window with a keybinding: o.bind("SUPER + SHIFT + J", "Omafin", "omarchy shell shell toggle dpetrariu.omafin '{}'")
